Carrot | Senior Software Engineers | Full-time | Remote

Carrot is an all-in-one platform for cannabis dispensaries (ecommerce, loyalty, marketing, apps, and delivery) with a small, high-impact, remote team. We use Scala + Scala.js with functional programming principles, but we value strong programming fundamentals over specific tech stack experience.

What makes this opportunity unique:

- Full remote work with flexible hours (just need availability during US Pacific mornings) - Direct impact on product direction in a growing industry - High autonomy with support through peer reviews and mentorship - Work directly with our CTO in a flat organization

We’re looking for senior engineers excited about working in a functional paradigm. Our interview process is refreshingly streamlined (1-2 interviews).

Full job description: https://www.notion.so/Job-Description-Senior-Full-Stack-Engi... Email seb at getcarrot.io with resumes or questions.
